literature_notes: The sole ledger entry [L1] reports a TREK-2-mCherry C-terminal fusion expressed in HEK-293 cells. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the C-terminus (residues 320–538) is entirely intracellular (INTRACELLULAR: 320–538; TM4 ends at 319). The mCherry fusion therefore sits on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag. The nanobody reagents (Nb58/Nb57-mVenus) described in the same paper bind the extracellular Cap domain of TREK-2 but are exogenous antibody-like probes, not insertions into the KCNK10 sequence — antibody epitope mapping is explicitly excluded. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at an extracellular position of KCNK10 or a close ortholog. Zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal mCherry fusion appended after the last residue (N538); the entire C-terminal tail (residues 320–538) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
